dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Observed 3-5 prominent O-shaped structures exhibit a transition from the dark dorsal background to high-contrast, light-gray circular perimeters. These perimeters have soft, diffuse outer edges that blend into the darker exterior field, while the interiors typically contain a lower-intensity central core.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of asymmetrical, solid high-intensity pixel clusters lacking internal gradients is observed, primarily concentrated along the upper dorsal-lateral boundary and between the larger annular structures.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three largest centrally located annular patterns form an obtuse triangle. Connecting these to the centroids of smaller high-intensity blobs in the upper quadrant reveals a localized network of polygonal geometric relationships.

other_distinctive_markers: A significant high-intensity specular highlight is present on the rightmost cranial region, characterized by saturated white pixels that create a sharp geometric boundary against the surrounding dark pelt.
